H1, H2, then another H1 creates two sibling top-level groups

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<h1>Chapter One</h1><h2>Section A</h2><p>Section A content.</p><h1>Chapter Two</h1><h2>Section B</h2><p>Section B content.</p>', HtmlToMarkdown::ConversionOptions.new(include_document_structure: true))
puts result.content.inspect
puts result.document.nodes.inspect
```
